operating_notes.text: Divested 13.18% stake in Yes Bank on Sep 17, 2025, resulting in a profit of ₹3,026.57 Cr.
Acquired additional 4.925% stake in SBI General Insurance, taking total holding to 73.87%.
Revalued freehold immovable properties on April 1, 2025, adding ₹77,288.48 Cr to Revaluation Reserve.
Board approved long-term fundraising of up to USD 2 billion in FY 2026-27 through bonds.
Priced USD 200 million Senior Unsecured Reg-S Fixed Rate Notes tap issue due September 2030 via London branch.
Corporate credit pipeline including undisbursed term loans, unutilised working capital and pipeline exceeds ₹9 lakh crore.
Gold loan book crossed ₹3.1 trillion as of 30 June (personal ₹1.25 trillion, agri ₹1.85 trillion) at yields of 8.5-8.9% and LTV under 55-56%.
Excess SLR was ₹3.06 lakh crore as on 30 June and about ₹4 lakh crore as of the meet, aided by FCNR(B) flows.
Bank experienced an incident involving exposure of 3,897 customer records containing PII on the dark web with no material impact on operations.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹131,080.12 Cr, net profit ₹20,161.3 Cr (+1.1% YoY).
State Bank of India declared a final dividend of ₹17.35 per equity share for FY26.
State Bank of India's board approved long-term fundraising of up to USD 2 billion via foreign currency bonds in FY27.
SBI held its Q4FY26 post-results analyst meet on May 8, 2026, guiding for 13-15% credit growth and stable NIM above 3% in FY27.

State Bank of India elected **Dr. Sandhya Shekhar**, **Shri K.R. Ashok**, **Shri Khurshed Rustom Dordi**, and **Shri Sandeep Natwarlal Shah** as directors for three years starting **June 26, 2026**, via postal ballot.
State Bank of India’s promoter (President of India, GoI) disclosed no encumbrance on equity shares for FY2026 on 07.04.2026 via Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
State Bank of India priced USD 200 million senior unsecured Reg-S fixed rate notes as a tap of its existing bond due in September 2030.
State Bank of India cancelled the Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet scheduled for 04.06.2026, as per DGM (Compliance & Company Secretary) Aruna N. Dak.
State Bank of India reported a customer data exposure incident affecting 3,897 records on the dark web with no material impact on operations.
